description: Footstep sounds by place on map6_s00 (Resort Area Otherworld). After the character's own footsteps table, every rule of "places" whose conditions all hold replaces the step sound, in file order, so the last match wins. Conditions (each optional): "surface" / "not_surface" (surface names of gamedata/world/surfaces.json), "room" (the map's room index), "x" / "z" ([min, max] of the player's position in metres, inclusive, null = open), "y_above" (metres; the player's y is greater, y grows downwards). They test the player's position for every character's step, as the original did. "sound" is a sound name of gamedata/sounds; "name" identifies the rule (on_footstep scripts see it as e.place, and a mod's maps/map6_s00/footsteps.json replaces or adds rules by name). Here five small spots of the Resort Area Otherworld streets get their own step sound.
